climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

notes: Martinborough is known for premium cool-climate Pinot Noir.
Its Pinot Noir often has darker fruit and more savory character than Marlborough's.

blurb.text: A geographical indication on New Zealand's North Island, in the wider Wairarapa area. New Zealand is known for premium cool-climate Pinot Noir from Martinborough.
